facebookresearch_hyperreel/losses.py.create_HuberLoss: create a HuberLoss module with configurable delta for robust regression training
facebookresearch_hyperreel/losses.py.create_MSELoss: create an MSELoss module that computes mean squared error between inputs and targets
facebookresearch_hyperreel/losses.py.create_WeightedMSELoss: create a WeightedMSELoss module that applies per-sample weights to squared error
facebookresearch_hyperreel/losses.py.create_ComplexMSELoss: create a ComplexMSELoss module that computes MSE on real and imaginary parts separately
facebookresearch_hyperreel/losses.py.create_MSETopN: create an MSETopN module that computes MSE on the top N worst samples by fraction

facebookresearch_hyperreel/main.py.run_INR_training: run the INR training pipeline with a Hydra config and PyTorch Lightning trainer
facebookresearch_hyperreel/main.py.run_elastic_multigpu: run elastic multi-GPU training using torch distributed launcher with the run function
facebookresearch_hyperreel/main.py.create_INRModelCheckpoint: create a custom ModelCheckpoint callback that saves the last top k checkpoints every N epochs
facebookresearch_hyperreel/main.py.run_Hydra_main: run the main entry point that uses Hydra to load config and start training
facebookresearch_hyperreel/main.py.review_INRModelCheckpoint_save_last: review the INRModelCheckpoint class _save_last_checkpoint method to understand epoch-based saving logic

facebookresearch_hyperreel/metrics.py.compute_mse: compute the mean squared error between predicted and ground truth image tensors
facebookresearch_hyperreel/metrics.py.compute_psnr: compute the peak signal to noise ratio between two images using scikit-image
facebookresearch_hyperreel/metrics.py.compute_ssim: compute the structural similarity index between two multichannel images with gaussian weights
facebookresearch_hyperreel/metrics.py.compute_psnr_gpu: compute the GPU-accelerated peak signal to noise ratio between predicted and ground truth tensors
facebookresearch_hyperreel/metrics.py.compute_ssim_gpu: compute the GPU-accelerated structural similarity index between two image tensors using kornia
